messages.content: The St. George Inn confirmation says standard king, but I selected the larger king room in the final comparison. The dates and $1,842.24 total look right. Can you verify what was actually reserved?

I can check the reservation record and ask the property to compare it with the room selected at checkout. I’ll also confirm availability, the revised total, deposit treatment, and whether changing the room affects the September 13 cancellation deadline.
Yes. Please don’t change anything until you know the full price and terms.

The property confirms SGI-927416 currently holds a standard king. It also found the checkout request for a deluxe king, which is the larger configuration. A deluxe king remains available for all seven nights, September 20-27.
What would the correction cost, and does it change the cancellation policy?

The corrected total would be $1,968.24, an increase of $126. Your $263.18 deposit would transfer to the amended reservation, leaving $1,705.06 due at check-in. Free cancellation would still run through 3:00 p.m. local hotel time on September 13; after that, the full stay would be nonrefundable. No new deposit or change fee applies.
That’s fine. Have them amend it to the deluxe king, with no extras or coverage added.

The property has amended confirmation SGI-927416 to one deluxe king room for two adults, September 20-27. The cancellation deadline remains 3:00 p.m. local hotel time on September 13, after which the entire stay is nonrefundable. A corrected confirmation has been issued.
